mapper.select: SELECT t.target_id, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM view_log v WHERE v.target_type=#{type} AND v.target_id=t.target_id) AS view_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM like_record l WHERE l.target_type=#{type} AND l.target_id=t.target_id) AS like_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM share_record s WHERE s.target_type=#{type} AND s.target_id=t.target_id) AS share_count FROM (SELECT #{id} AS target_id) t
